move.instructions: Which review move does reviewer_comment make? Pick the one that best describes the problem it raises or the improvement it asks for.

criteria.missed_case: A specific input, state, variant or configuration the code does not handle
criteria.wrong_condition_or_value: A wrong condition, constant, offset, index, variable or off-by-one
criteria.state_update_error: State updated twice, not updated, not reset, or shared where it should be per request or per call
criteria.hidden_control_flow: An implicit return, exception, early exit, callback or alternate path the change does not account for
criteria.not_behaviour_preserving: A refactor or rewrite that silently changes the old behaviour
criteria.partial_failure_consistency: Operations not undone on rollback, abort or partial failure, leaving inconsistent state
criteria.error_path_cleanup: A leak, double free or use-after-free on an error, cancellation or shutdown path, or ownership transfer not reflected
criteria.error_lost_or_unchecked: An error code clobbered, swallowed, unchecked or wrongly propagated, or a null or failure result not checked
criteria.arithmetic_bounds: Integer overflow, truncation, signedness, missing bounds check or out-of-range access
criteria.blocking_under_lock: Blocking, waiting, I/O, callbacks or expensive work while holding a lock
criteria.race_condition: Unsynchronised shared state, check-then-act, or concurrent operations interfering
criteria.ordering_staleness: Stale data, wrong ordering of operations, memory ordering, or inconsistent snapshots
criteria.lifetime_ownership: Object lifetime, dangling references, ownership, reference counting or GC roots
criteria.security_boundary: Untrusted input, authorisation, information leaks, secret handling or security decisions
criteria.hot_path_cost: Unnecessary cost on a hot path, a cheaper primitive or algorithm, or a compile-time or runtime blow-up
criteria.compat_break: Breaks existing users, callers, ABI, wire or file formats, persisted data or defaults
criteria.spec_contract_mismatch: Disagrees with a specification, standard, RFC, accepted proposal or documented contract
criteria.api_misuse: Uses an existing API, helper or framework facility incorrectly or not as intended
criteria.reuse_existing: Duplicates an existing helper or mechanism, or ignores the project's established pattern for this
criteria.wrong_place: Logic or state lives in the wrong layer, module or object, or works by action at a distance
criteria.simpler_design: A simpler or more robust overall approach to the same goal
criteria.rollout_gating: Feature flags, gates, fallbacks, rollback safety or configuration defaults
criteria.platform_assumption: Endianness, alignment, architecture, OS, compiler or toolchain assumptions
criteria.missing_test: Asks for a test of a specific case, path or regression
criteria.test_quality: A test that is flaky, non-deterministic, does not test what it claims, or depends on its environment
criteria.explain_document: Asks to explain, comment or document an invariant, rationale or non-obvious behaviour
criteria.naming_readability: Naming, clarity or structure of the code without a behavioural problem
